title: Heritage Sweet And Innocent Collection Kristy D-90 Handcrafted Porcelain Doll
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: This is a vintage Heritage Signature porcelain doll from the Sweet And Innocent Collection, specifically the Kristy D-90 model. The doll is 15 inches tall and is part of the Heritage Mint, Ltd. brand. The doll is a boy named Michael and is handcrafted with porcelain material. The set includes the doll, making it a valuable addition to any doll collection.
